name: studio
description: Native-first autonomous agent team with outcome-based work classification and continuation accounting, persistent brainstorm, isolated development, and strict quality gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run a quality-gated, outcome-accounted living agent team.
interface.longDescription: The owner gives a mission; Studio classifies the work, selects the minimum sufficient crew and review path, and accounts for delivered outcomes separately from motion and telemetry. It preserves adversarial QA, strict critics, judgment diversity, worktree isolation, single-owner reviews, and the integrated full gate.
defaultPrompt: Use $producer to run a mission through the living agent team.
The producer convenes crew into background runs; it never makes artifacts itself.
Require artifact and context evidence to pass QualityPlan floors before integration.
Use WorkPacket v2 work classification for new dispatches; mixed or unknown work fails closed to standard judgment.
Continue only from a material, criterion-linked, single-use review decision; terminal decisions require a new owner-approved cycle.
Treat quality completion as the delivery gate and telemetry completion only as the efficiency-claim gate.
Use task-worker without GitHub, task-github for GitHub delivery, and never lease both for one track.
Use session-review selectively for major or independence-required review edges.
Owner gates: mission contract, new epic, irreversible, external-publish, budget-raise.
